changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE poems DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS search_vec
ALTER TABLE poems ADD COLUMN search_vec tsvector

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_poems_search_vec ON poems
CREATE TRIGGER trg_poems_search_vec BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF name, content, author_id ON poems FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION poems_search_vec_trg()

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_authors_refresh_search ON authors
CREATE TRIGGER trg_authors_refresh_search AFTER UPDATE OF name ON authors FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.name) EXECUTE FUNCTION authors_refresh_poems_search()

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: UPDATE poems p SET search_vec = setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.name, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(a.name, ''))), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.content, ''))), 'C') FROM authors a WHERE a.id = p.author_id
UPDATE poems SET search_vec = setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(name, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(content, ''))), 'C') WHERE author_id IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_poems_search_vec ON poems USING gin (search_vec)
